company_summary.text: Kirkland Signature demonstrates strong environmental practices by reducing single-use plastic across its bottled water line. The company has transitioned to lighter packaging and improved recycling rates within its supply chain.
The brand has invested in energy-efficient bottling facilities and collaborates with local water suppliers to ensure responsible water sourcing and minimal waste generation.
Kirkland also reports annually on its ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) metrics, showcasing progress toward sustainable manufacturing and ethical supply chain management.
